projectDescription: Archer is a fully on-chain order book exchange on Solana, built for traders and market makers to access deep, liquid markets with best-in-class adverse selection protection.
keyFeatures: Dedicated per-maker order books (MakerBooks) with zero write contention
On-chain matching engine with price priority pro rata execution
Asynchronous swap execution with configurable slot delay for adverse selection protection
Resting limit orders via TakerOrderBook (up to 256 active orders per market)
Sync spread ticks — automatic spread widening for atomic/synchronous flow
Sync fee multiplier — configurable fee scaling for synchronous vs asynchronous swaps
Integrator fee revenue sharing (50% of taker fees for aggregators)
publicApiSurface: MakerBook — UpdateMidPrice instruction (recenter all levels around new mid price)
MakerBook — CancelAll instruction (O(1) cancel all orders)
TakerOrderBook — resting limit orders (128 bids + 128 asks per market)
Synchronous swap — instant market order execution
Asynchronous swap — intent-based execution with n-slot delay
Market configuration — taker_fee_ppm, maker_fee_ppm, sync_fee_multiplier, min/max slot delay
